purpose: Optional four-player tiny far models; derive from the current source-based packed far bank, never from checked-in game geometry.

aliases.plasma_pistol: Smaller candidates lost shell mass or filled the opening and spread the green emitter color.
aliases.sniper: Smaller candidates lost receiver, scope and bipod mass, including empty native views.
aliases.rocket: Smaller candidates erased barrel mass or the pale barrel band.
aliases.healthpack: The existing far model is already small; the tested reduction lost red and white surface cues for four vertices.
aliases.scorpion: Smaller candidates lost the barrel or track mass; a whole hull filled the track gaps.

quality_notes.needler: The 44-triangle candidate retains the central blue body and pink needle outline. The weaker 12, 20, 28 and 36 budgets were rejected.
quality_notes.warthog: Restore all original far-model faces of material 3 after collapse, preserving the red rear lamps verbatim.
quality_notes.ghost: The 64-triangle candidate retains wing mass and purple cues; smaller candidates were rejected at eight pixels.
quality_notes.banshee: The 64-triangle candidate retains the aircraft outline. Rare three-pixel glint shifts in six-pixel offline probes require target review.
quality_notes.plasma_rifle: Two four-pixel phases gain a pixel where the old far model is empty; no sampled phase loses a previously visible whole model.
quality_notes.shotgun: The support hull preserves outer mass while filling small recesses and averaging incident source colors.
quality_notes.frag: The support hull preserves round outer mass while filling small recesses and averaging incident source colors.
